title: Steam Navigator item content file (Content Schema 2.0)
description: Merged trade item family (C2): the former `goods` and `materials` content types now share one active type. `data.crafting_material` marks items that can be consumed by crafting/refit recipes; every other market field (weight, price, stock, elasticity, spawn weight, category, tier) is the union of the two legacy schemas. Content Schema 2.0 drops the 1.0 goods/material types and their ids.

item_data.description: Union of the legacy good_data and material_data blocks. `crafting_material` replaces the old content-type split: true = consumable by recipes (old materials plus craftable goods such as timber/brass/iron ore), false = pure trade/supply item.

crafting_material.description: 是否可作为打造 / 改装材料消耗。old materials 恒为 true；old goods 中原本可打造者保留 true。

spawn_weight.description: 市场随机进货权重；0 = 只按供需/补给规则出现。

category.description: 自由分类标签（ore/metal/plate/supply 等），市场与 UI 分组用。

tier.description: 材料品质等级；普通商品可省略。
